lessons.title: Sabantuy
lessons.context: A family goes to the summer festival.

paragraphs.tt: Узган шимбәдә без Сабантуйга бардык.
paragraphs.en: Last Saturday we went to Sabantuy.

paragraphs.tt: Мәйданда бик күп кеше бар иде.
paragraphs.en: There were very many people in the square.

paragraphs.tt: Ирләр көрәште, ә балалар капчык киеп йөгерде.
paragraphs.en: The men wrestled, and the children ran in sacks.

paragraphs.tt: Мин тәмле чәкчәк ашадым һәм кымыз эчтем.
paragraphs.en: I ate tasty chak-chak and drank kumis.

paragraphs.tt: Киләсе елда без тагын барачакбыз.
paragraphs.en: Next year we will go again.

questions.question: When did they go to Sabantuy?
What did the men do?
What did the narrator eat?
What will they do next year?

paragraphs.tt: Былтыр безнең гаилә яңа фатирга күченде.
paragraphs.en: Last year our family moved to a new flat.

paragraphs.tt: Яңа фатир иске фатирдан зуррак.
paragraphs.en: The new flat is bigger than the old one.

paragraphs.tt: Анда өч бүлмә һәм зур аш бүлмәсе бар.
paragraphs.en: It has three rooms and a big kitchen.

paragraphs.tt: Минем бүлмәмнең тәрәзәсеннән елга күренә.
paragraphs.en: You can see the river from my room's window.

paragraphs.tt: Мин яңа фатирны бик яратам.
paragraphs.en: I like the new flat very much.

questions.question: When did the family move?
How is the new flat different?
What can be seen from the narrator's window?
How many rooms are there?

paragraphs.tt: Җәен мин әти-әнием белән Мәскәүгә бардым.
paragraphs.en: In summer I went to Moscow with my parents.

paragraphs.tt: Без поездда унике сәгать бардык.
paragraphs.en: We travelled by train for twelve hours.

paragraphs.tt: Мәскәүдә без Кызыл мәйданны һәм музейларны карадык.
paragraphs.en: In Moscow we saw Red Square and the museums.

paragraphs.tt: Һава эссе иде, шуңа күрә без күп туңдырма ашадык.
paragraphs.en: The weather was hot, so we ate a lot of ice cream.

paragraphs.tt: Өйгә арып, ләкин бәхетле булып кайттык.
paragraphs.en: We came home tired but happy.

questions.question: Who did the narrator travel with?
How did they travel?
What was the weather like?
How did they feel coming home?

lessons.title: At the Doctor's
lessons.context: Someone falls ill and gets better.

paragraphs.tt: Кичә минем башым һәм тамагым авыртты.
paragraphs.en: Yesterday my head and throat hurt.

paragraphs.tt: Мин табибка бардым.
paragraphs.en: I went to the doctor.

paragraphs.tt: Табиб мине карады һәм миңа дару бирде.
paragraphs.en: The doctor examined me and gave me medicine.

paragraphs.tt: Ул миңа өч көн өйдә ятарга кушты.
paragraphs.en: She told me to stay in bed at home for three days.

paragraphs.tt: Бүген мин инде яхшырак.
paragraphs.en: Today I'm already better.

questions.question: What hurt?
What did the doctor give?
How long should he stay at home?
How is he today?

paragraphs.tt: Шимбә көнне әниемнең туган көне.
paragraphs.en: On Saturday it's my mother's birthday.

paragraphs.tt: Мин аңа бүләк алырга телим.
paragraphs.en: I want to buy her a present.

paragraphs.tt: Кибеттә матур яулыклар күп иде.
paragraphs.en: There were lots of beautiful headscarves in the shop.

paragraphs.tt: Мин зәңгәр яулык сайладым, ул кыйммәт түгел иде.
paragraphs.en: I chose a blue headscarf; it wasn't expensive.

paragraphs.tt: Әнием бүләкне бик ошатыр дип уйлыйм.
paragraphs.en: I think my mother will really like the present.

questions.question: When is the mother's birthday?
What was in the shop?
What colour did the narrator choose?
Was it expensive?

paragraphs.tt: Кичә мин сәгать җидедә тордым.
paragraphs.en: Yesterday I got up at seven o'clock.

paragraphs.tt: Иртәнге аштан соң мин эшкә киттем.
paragraphs.en: After breakfast I went to work.

paragraphs.tt: Эштә көн бик озын булды.
paragraphs.en: The day at work was very long.

paragraphs.tt: Кичен мин дустым белән паркта йөрдем.
paragraphs.en: In the evening I walked in the park with my friend.

paragraphs.tt: Сәгать уникедә мин йокларга яттым.
paragraphs.en: At twelve o'clock I went to bed.

questions.question: When did the narrator get up?
Where did he go after breakfast?
What did he do in the evening?
options: Walked in the park with a friend

questions.question: When did he go to bed?

paragraphs.tt: Минем энем футболны бик ярата.
paragraphs.en: My younger brother loves football.

paragraphs.tt: Ул атнага өч тапкыр тренировкага йөри.
paragraphs.en: He goes to training three times a week.

paragraphs.tt: Узган якшәмбедә аның командасы уйнады.
paragraphs.en: Last Sunday his team played.

paragraphs.tt: Алар өч-бер исәбе белән җиңде.
paragraphs.en: They won three to one.

paragraphs.tt: Энем ике гол кертте, без аның белән горурланабыз.
paragraphs.en: My brother scored two goals, and we're proud of him.

questions.question: How often does the brother train?
When did the team play?
What was the score?
How many goals did the brother score?

paragraphs.tt: Безнең шәһәрдә кыш озын һәм салкын.
paragraphs.en: In our town winter is long and cold.

paragraphs.tt: Кар ноябрьдә ява башлый.
paragraphs.en: Snow starts falling in November.

paragraphs.tt: Ял көннәрендә без урманга чаңгы шуарга барабыз.
paragraphs.en: At weekends we go skiing in the forest.

paragraphs.tt: Аннары өйдә кайнар чәй эчәбез.
paragraphs.en: Then we drink hot tea at home.

paragraphs.tt: Мин кышны җәйдән күбрәк яратам.
paragraphs.en: I like winter more than summer.

questions.question: What is winter like in the town?
When does the snow start?
What do they do at weekends?
Which season does the narrator prefer?

lessons.title: Learning Tatar
lessons.context: A learner looks back on two years of study.

paragraphs.tt: Мин татар телен ике ел өйрәнәм.
paragraphs.en: I've been learning Tatar for two years.

paragraphs.tt: Башта миңа бик кыен иде.
paragraphs.en: At first it was very hard for me.

paragraphs.tt: Хәзер мин татарча китаплар укый алам.
paragraphs.en: Now I can read books in Tatar.

paragraphs.tt: Мин көн саен яңа сүзләр язам.
paragraphs.en: Every day I write down new words.

paragraphs.tt: Киләсе җәйдә мин Казанга барырга телим.
paragraphs.en: Next summer I want to go to Kazan.

questions.question: How long has the narrator been learning?
What was it like at first?
What can the narrator do now?
What does the narrator want to do next summer?

paragraphs.tt: Якшәмбе көнне әбием бәлеш пешерде.
paragraphs.en: On Sunday my grandmother baked a pie.

paragraphs.tt: Ул камыр ясады, ит һәм бәрәңге турады.
paragraphs.en: She made the dough and chopped meat and potatoes.

paragraphs.tt: Бәлеш мичтә ике сәгать пеште.
paragraphs.en: The pie baked in the oven for two hours.

paragraphs.tt: Бөтен гаилә өстәл янына җыелды.
paragraphs.en: The whole family gathered at the table.

paragraphs.tt: Бәлеш бик тәмле булды, без барысын да ашадык.
paragraphs.en: The pie was very tasty, and we ate all of it.
